name: axhub
description: Claude Code plugin for axhub. Natural-language axhub requests should route to one of onboarding/bootstrap/deploy/import/development/diagnosis/update before ordinary Code-mode shell work; clarity is manual/explicit-only for exact CLI ops like logs/env/rollback/table/connector/GitHub reconnect. Import priority is strict: if a prompt asks axhub to bring or first-deploy an existing app/local folder, including `기존 앱`, `기존 Express 서버 앱`, `이미 만든 앱`, `작업 폴더는`, `이 폴더 axhub에 올려`, Express/FastAPI/Django/Go/Dockerfile apps, invoke the axhub import skill before generic Code-mode folder inspection, file reads, shell probes, bootstrap, deploy, or update unless explicit freshness words are present. The first visible import text should start exactly `기존 앱을 axhub에 가져올 준비를 확인할게요.` Routing priority is strict: if a prompt asks axhub 최신, 버전 확인, 업데이트, latest, up to date, version check, update, or upgrade, invoke the axhub update skill first; first visible assistant text is exactly `현재 버전을 확인할게요.` A narrow Code-mode update router reinforces this contract through SessionStart context plus a UserPromptSubmit match when freshness words appear; it adds routing context only, not commands. General helper-role phrasing without freshness words must not invoke update. Mixed freshness prompts like `axhub가 진짜 최신인지 먼저 확인해주고, 내 앱들이 지금 어떤 상태인지도 알아서 봐줘. 그다음 새 앱 만들어서 실제로 배포까지 해줘.` continue after update. After update, plugin lookup uses exact `claude plugin list`, never `claude plugin list 2>&1`; once the remaining app-status flow begins, do not rerun command-v, version probes, plugin-location checks, or `claude plugin list`. Continue app status/create/deploy in the same conversation, and for app status overview use exact `axhub apps --help` then `axhub apps list --json`; when folder/current conversation/latest list clearly identifies a related app, do not ask which app, and run exact `axhub apps get <app> --json` plus `axhub deploy list --app <app> --json` before any summary; never nonexistent `axhub app list`, never `axhub deployment list`, never `command -v axhub && axhub --version`, never `command -v claude && claude plugin list`, never `claude plugin list 2>&1 | grep`, never Claude Desktop axhub App/MCP permission popups, and never &&, pipes, redirects, grep, or head. Never start freshness prompts with `Using /axhub:clarity`, run scripts, shell/version probes, app-status tools, Claude Desktop axhub App/MCP tools, clarity, bootstrap, deploy, /oh-my-claudecode:autopilot, unrelated plugin modes, or generic Code-mode handling. Korean-first skills call ax-hub-cli v0.20.0+ surfaces directly, with preview-confirm deploy, verify-based success, existing-app import, read-only diagnosis, and CLI-only manual clarity.
